name: Guten Corex – Supercharge Gutenberg Like Pro
author: Binsaifullah

sections.description:
Guten CoreX supercharges your Gutenberg editor by adding powerful new design capabilities to the existing core blocks. Whether you’re a designer, developer, or site owner, Guten Corex helps you unlock advanced features without writing a single line of code.

Explore GutenLayouts

Extensions List

  • Image Masking
  • Gallery Lightbox
  • SVG Icon for Button
  • Entrance Animation
  • Custom CSS
  • Shape Divider
  • Responsive Visibility

🌟 Key Features

✅ Masking – Add beautiful masking to image block.
✅ Lightbox – Add lightbox to image gallery block.
✅ SVG Icon – Add SVG Font awesome icon to button block.
✅ Entrance Animations – Entrance animations to any blocks.
✅ Custom CSS – Easily add custom styles to individual blocks directly from the editor.
✅ Responsive Visibility – Show or hide blocks on desktop, tablet, or mobile.
✅ Shape Divider – Add beautiful SVG shape dividers above or below blocks.
✅ Designed to be minimal, fast-loading, and fully optimized for speed.
✅ Built on top of core blocks; disable anytime without breaking your content.
✅ Complete Font Awesome SVG icon library included.

🧩 Perfect For

  • Bloggers
  • Web Designers
  • Agencies
  • Freelancers
  • Anyone using the Gutenberg block editor
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/gutencorex directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress
sections.faq:
Can I use this with any theme?

Yes, Guten Corex works with all themes that support the WordPress Block Editor (Gutenberg).

Will it slow down my website?

No. Guten Corex is lightweight and only loads scripts when needed to keep your site fast.

Is Guten Corex compatible with Full Site Editing (FSE)?

Yes, Guten Corex is fully compatible with WordPress Full Site Editing (FSE) and block-based themes.

Can I disable a specific feature?

Yes, you can disable any feature from the plugin settings page in the WordPress admin area.
